name: Pool Deck
look: Night on the pool deck at Vic's lakehouse. A balcony guard walks a flashlight across the boards. There is no dry place the beam will miss. The pool might.

hotspots.look: Dark water, big enough to hide a man if he stays under.
A maintenance shed by the water. The beam owns the walk to it until the balcony is empty.
A guard on the balcony, and a flashlight that does not sit still. The deck is his.
